summary: Verified the redesigned 'Tu link' 3-button strip on /tarjeta (mobile 390x844) in both ES and EN, plus global button containment across 8 main pages. The strip now stacks ICON-ON-TOP / TEXT-BELOW (flex-direction:column, h-auto py-2.5, text-xs) and the critical Spanish label 'Compartir' renders on EXACTLY ONE line (textWidth=60px on a ~103px-wide button, lineHeight=16, 1 line) with no word-splitting. All 3 buttons are contained (scrollW==clientW=101, scrollH==clientH=56, size ~103x58). Functional flows still work: Copiar triggers 'Link copied' toast; Compartir invokes share; Ver is an <a target='_blank'> linking to the public mini-site. Multi-page audit (/, /trabajos, /clientes, /cotizaciones, /facturas, /marketing/inicio, /tarjeta, /perfil) shows ZERO overflowing buttons (scrollW>clientW) and ZERO horizontal page scroll (document.body.scrollWidth = 390 = viewport.innerWidth) in both ES and EN. Task add regression on dashboard verified in prior iter42 and confirmed still present (task-title-input + task-add-btn).

critical_code_review_comments: CardAdmin.js (lines 275-281): grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 with three buttons className='flex-col gap-1 h-auto py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs' produces a clean icon-on-top / label-below layout in both languages. 'Compartir' (60px text) fits on one line inside a ~101px-wide button — the original word-splitting issue is GONE.

button.jsx (line 8): base class 'inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 min-w-0 break-words text-center leading-tight ...' (no whitespace-nowrap) is the correct global blindaje — keeps multi-word long labels contained without ever splitting words mid-letter (break-words breaks at spaces, not inside words, unlike overflow-wrap:anywhere).

rca_of_the_issue: Original issue: in the /tarjeta 'Tu link' strip, the 3 buttons used a horizontal icon+label layout in a grid-cols-3 with very narrow cells (~100px). With the previous Button base 'whitespace-nowrap', long Spanish labels like 'Compartir' (+icon) overflowed and were visually broken into hyphenated halves on two visual lines ('Co-mpa-rtir'). FIX (verified): (a) The Button base in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/button.jsx now uses 'min-w-0 break-words text-center leading-tight' (no whitespace-nowrap), letting text wrap by spaces and keeping the button width contained. (b) The /tarjeta strip in /app/frontend/src/pages/CardAdmin.js (lines 276-280) was redesigned with 'flex-col gap-1 h-auto py-2.5 text-xs' so the icon stacks on top and the label sits on its own line below. With this layout, even 'Compartir' takes only ~60px on a single visual line, well under the 101px cell width — no wrapping, no splitting, no overflow.
